curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a young street hustler find a better life beyond the rigors and temptations around him?
curatedMovie.description: Seeking a better life, a young street hustler tries to leave behind the rigors and temptations surrounding him.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful crime drama with steady pacing, demanding engaged focus for an intense solo watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Allen and Albert Hughes, this crime thriller delivers a heavy, suspenseful look at the desperate struggle to walk away from street life.
